title: Deductible Rewards Escalating Annual Credit, Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage
content:
**Program term.** The annual credit of a Deductible Rewards claim-free year under Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage rises with the claim-free years already credited on the vehicle: where the coverage already holds two or more claim-free-year credit entries, the annual credit is 150; where it holds exactly one, the annual credit is 125; where it holds none, the annual credit is the option's Deductible Rewards annual credit.

Only credit entries granted for a claim-free year count; the enrollment credit entry does not.

| Claim-free-year credit entries already on the coverage | Annual credit (USD) |
|---|---|
| Two or more | 150 |
| Exactly one | 125 |
| None | The option's annual credit, as below |

| Deductible option | Option's annual credit (USD) |
|---|---|
| Cardinal Physical Damage $2,000 Deductible | 0 |
| Cardinal Physical Damage $1,000 Deductible | 100 |
| Cardinal Physical Damage $750 Deductible | 100 |
| Cardinal Physical Damage $500 Deductible | 100 |
| Cardinal Physical Damage $250 Deductible | 100 |
| Cardinal Physical Damage $100 Deductible | 0 |

## Illustrations (hypothetical coverages)

- A vehicle on the $500 option whose only credit entry so far is the enrollment credit earns its first claim-free year: annual credit 100.
- The same vehicle at its next claim-free year, holding one claim-free-year entry: 125.
- At the following year, holding two: 150, and 150 for every later year.
